fields.name: Tactic/Behavior
fields.description: Set if this SmartBlock should Popover and interrupt the visitor journey or Overlay in a fixed position, but allow the visitor to continue without interacting

fields.name: Show After Fixed Time (Seconds)
fields.description: Display the popover after this number of seconds, even if there has been no intent to exit. Set to 0 if you don't wish to have a fixed delay.

fields.name: Show On Exit Intent
fields.description: Show the Popover when the user shows an intent to leave the page by moving their mouse towards the close page button.

fields.name: Minimum Days Between Showing
fields.description: Once the user has seen the SmartBlock, they will not be shown it again for this number of days, on the current device. Setting this to 0 or Cookie Name being blank will result in it always showing.

fields.name: Cookie Name
fields.description: Set the cookie name to be set when the user sees the SmartBlock, to prevent it appearing again within the time period set. Popover SmartBlocks that share a cookie name will all be hidden for the period, when one is dismissed. Ensure this name is different to display multiple popover SmartBlocks on the same site, simultaneously. These cookies are first party cookies, whose settings can be found here.

fields.name: Animation Type
fields.description: Set how the popover appears on screen

fields.name: Animation Duration
fields.description: Set the duration over which the animation runs (in seconds)

fields.name: Show on Every Page Load
fields.description: Determines whether the cookie value is ignored. If set, the popup / form is shown each time a person visits the page regardless of their history. Useful for testing.

fields.name: Custom Signal/Trigger
fields.description: This is a custom signal that will be raised against the person, each time the data capture form is submitted. The custom signal will be linked to a custom Trigger, which can be configured to send the data to a third party, such as an ESP. The custom signal can also be used within Slot rules, to show different content to people that have submitted, and Segment rules, to build a segment of all those that have submitted.

fields.description: Redirect to this URL when somebody clicks on the button in the success message
